summary: Gunner stacking toned down, Sorcerer late game buffed, small item pass on Bloodthirster and Redemption.

changes.description: 6-piece attack damage per stack reduced from 14% to 12%.
6-piece team ability power increased from 20 to 25.
Rocket launcher splash damage reduced by 10% at 2 stars.
Ascension attack range bonus now also applies at 1 star.
Shield threshold raised from 33% to 40% health.
Heal reduced from 18% to 15% of missing health.

summary: Season opener: Vanguard rework, Duelist dodge added at 6, economy augments rebalanced.

changes.description: Reworked: resists now double above 50% health instead of flat scaling.
Silver Bolts true damage increased from 7% to 8% max health.
Depth Charge stun duration reduced from 2.5 to 2 seconds.
No longer grants bonus gold on round win.
